nuevos.descripcion:
🩺 Get your personalized health plan: https://drstanfield.com/health-72d
🍵 Potassium Fiber drink: https://potassiumfiber.com/yt-72d

The trials often used to argue that seed oils are harmful had serious flaws: the Minnesota trial, whose missing data turned up in a basement, kept people on the diet for only about a year on average, and the Sydney trial was small.

In studies that followed nearly 69,000 people for up to 32 years, those carrying more linoleic acid, the main fat in most seed oils, had less cardiovascular disease, though studies that only watch people can't prove cause, and that analysis was part-funded by Unilever.

Regular seed oil breaks down fastest in frying tests, and beef tallow, like butter, is about half saturated fat, and saturated fat raises LDL cholesterol, so for cooking, olive oil looks like the better choice.

El Dr. Carlos Jaramillo explica por qué la #Demencia va en aumento en todo el mundo, cuándo un olvido es normal y qué factores de riesgo sí están en tus manos para cuidar tu memoria.

¿Se te queda un nombre en la punta de la lengua? Eso le pasa a todo el mundo y es más frecuente con los años, aunque el cerebro esté sano: el nombre está guardado y termina apareciendo. La demencia es otra cosa: es la pérdida de memoria y de las capacidades que una persona necesita para desenvolverse en su día a día, y el #Alzheimer es su tipo más común.

Un metaanálisis publicado en JAMA Neurology con 22 cohortes de 18 países calcula que los casos nuevos de demencia pasarán de 11,4 millones en 2023 a 24,7 millones en 2050, con más casos en mujeres y en países de ingresos bajos y medios como los de América Latina. Al mismo tiempo, el estudio Framingham y otros de Europa y Estados Unidos muestran que el riesgo de cada persona a una misma edad viene bajando en varios países. Las dos cosas son ciertas: vivimos más años, y la edad sigue siendo el mayor factor de riesgo.

nuevos.titulo_original: “Ozempic Face” Better skin, bigger problems?
nuevos.descripcion:
The appetite suppression that makes a GLP-1 work is also where the muscle problem starts. When you’re eating a fraction of what you used to, protein is usually the first thing to fall short, and without enough protein or a training stimulus your body has very little reason to hold on to muscle.

In the STEP 1 semaglutide trial, DXA scans in a subgroup showed close to 40% of the weight lost was lean mass. Lean mass on DXA includes more than skeletal muscle so I’d like to see muscle measured directly, but it tells you the number on the scale can’t show you what you’re losing.

This matters more as you get older. With anabolic resistance, muscle responds less to the same protein and the same training, so muscle lost over a few months on these meds is much harder to build back. Skeletal muscle is where most of your glucose gets disposed of, and it’s what keeps you strong and independent later in life.

If you’re on a GLP-1 or about to start one, anchor your first meal with 30-50g of protein and aim for roughly 1g per pound of target body weight across the day. Lift 2-3 times a week and stay on top of hydration, since you’re eating and drinking less. Ideally all of this is in place before the first dose, with a doctor monitoring you.

nuevos.descripcion:
A new trial found that when mothers took a choline supplement during pregnancy, their children scored about 8 points higher on an IQ test at age four. It almost seems too good to be true.

Between 2017 and 2021, about 200 pregnant women in Colorado were randomly assigned at 16 weeks of pregnancy. Half took 9 grams of phosphatidylcholine a day, about 1.3 grams of choline, nearly three times the recommended amount. The other half took placebo capsules filled with corn oil. They took them until the baby was born.

At age four, children in the choline group averaged an IQ of 106, against 98 with placebo, though the uncertainty runs from about 2 to about 14 points. On a parent questionnaire, 24% of children in the placebo group scored 2 or more on social withdrawal, against 4% in the choline group. Eleven children scored in the range that would prompt a referral for an autism assessment and also had language difficulties: 10 in the placebo group and 1 in the choline group. Attention problems, one of the two main things measured, didn't clearly differ.

Frank utiliza la pizarra para explicar cómo responde el cuerpo ante situaciones estresantes y qué sucede cuando estas se prolongan.

**Las tres etapas del estrés que presenta Frank Suárez:**

1. **Alarma:** el organismo detecta una situación estresante y activa mecanismos de respuesta, incluyendo la liberación de hormonas relacionadas con el estrés, como el cortisol.

2. **Resistencia:** el cuerpo continúa adaptándose a la situación estresante. Frank habla de cambios en la glucosa, la presión arterial, el pulso, el sueño y otros procesos del organismo.

3. **Agotamiento:** en el modelo de Selye, representa una fase en la que la exposición prolongada al estrés supera la capacidad de adaptación del organismo.

- Qué es el cortisol y dónde se produce.

A large network meta-analysis of 270 randomized controlled trials found that isometric exercise, particularly wall squats, produced substantial blood pressure reductions, often exceeding 6–10 mmHg.

But how frequently do you need to perform these exercises?

In a new randomized controlled trial, researchers initially trained participants for four weeks before assigning them to stop exercising or continue once, twice, or three times per week for another four weeks.

The results were impressive.

Three weekly sessions produced the greatest reductions, with systolic blood pressure decreasing by more than 10 mmHg.

nuevos.descripcion:
[김형수의 더마talk] 지방제거를 통한 팔자주름의 치료

팔자주름을 개선하려면 꺼진 부위를 채워야 한다고 생각하기 쉬운데요. 반대로 지방을 줄이는 접근이 필요한 경우도 있을까요?

팔자주름의 모양에는 피부 탄력, 지방의 양과 분포, 얼굴 골격과 표정근육 등 여러 요소가 영향을 줍니다. 특히 주름 주변 조직의 두께 차이와 지방의 돌출이 팔자주름을 더 뚜렷하게 보이게 할 수 있는데요.

따라서 팔자주름 치료를 고민할 때는 꺼진 부분과 도드라진 부분을 함께 살펴보고, 어떤 요소가 주름을 강조하는지 확인하는 것이 중요합니다.

이번 [김형수의 더마talk]에서는
팔자주름이 생기는 다양한 원인과 얼굴 지방의 역할,
팔자주름 주변 지방의 분포가 얼굴 인상에 미치는 영향,
지방제거를 고려할 수 있는 경우와 신중해야 하는 경우,
지방을 줄이는 치료와 볼륨을 보완하는 치료의 차이,
피부 처짐이나 탄력 저하를 함께 평가해야 하는 이유,
과도한 지방제거로 생길 수 있는 볼꺼짐·비대칭 등의 문제,
그리고 치료 전 확인해야 할 사항과 회복 과정까지 알아봅니다.

특히 “팔자주름 위쪽이 불룩하면 지방을 제거하는 게 좋을까요?”, “지방을 빼면 오히려 볼이 꺼지거나 처져 보이지 않을까요?”, “필러나 리프팅을 함께 고려해야 하는 경우는 언제인가요?” 등 많은 분들이 궁금해하는 질문들을 함께 살펴봅니다.
